response.overview: Raghav is an Indian Assamese-language action film produced by JB Production and directed by Jatin Bora. The film's cast includes Jatin Bora, Nishita Goswami, Mridula Boruah, Hiranya Deka and Sumi Borah. It was released on 27 October 2023. Raghav, a taxi driver by profession, is a complex and tragic figure. He is a man who loves and cares deeply for his mother and younger brother, even though they hate him for reasons unknown to him. Despite their rejection, Raghav never fails to provide for them, sacrificing everything he has for their well-being. His unwavering devotion to his family, despite their hatred, keeps him committed rarely pursuing the answers he craves for.
response.title: Raghav
